issue_records.title: Avoid mutating filters.
issue_records.body_excerpt:
This PR changes the mutating function `set_local!(filter, odr, dataspace, datasetcreationprops)` to the non-mutating
`set_local(filter, odr, dataspace, datasetcreationprops)` and also makes `Shuffle` a `struct` instead of a `mutable struct`.

This is not a breaking change because `set_local!` is not used by any plugins yet, and currently, the internal filter interface is still experimental.

I imagine people will create global variables with filter options like:

```
const filters = [Shuffle(), Deflate()]
```

And then reuse this in multiple threads. With the current `set_local!` function for `Shuffle`, this would be a race condition.
This PR fixes that issue.
